SCE.S:242054: My high school girlfriend, met again after 12 years. Married after I left the City; single now.
SCE.S:242120: Came to meet his uncle here. The uncle taught him games as a boy.
SCE.S:2421EC: In town for a reunion. Has a son in college and a daughter in high school. Won't see them again.
SCE.S:2422B8: "This City is sealed off! No one's noticed! Everyone's going mad! They're all enemies!"
SCE.S:242384: Ex-tax accountant posing as a cop. Guards the City's gate, deciding who leaves and who enters.
SCE.S:242450: The fourth agent, sent in secret by top officials who sensed the City's "anomaly." A war hero.
SCE.S:24251C: Crowds once used this station daily. Since the highway opened, few come. He feels lonely.
